purpose: Human/external scientific review preparation; not a scientific contract, decision, authority proposal or freeze.
head: c0d97f1f1281e99898b908af8dd9c8e1f81056d1
question: What scientific statement, if any, may Pelora truthfully make from its existing horizontal radial-geometry candidate, and what evidence (if any) is necessary before that statement may be represented as currentConvergenceDetected=true or contribute convergence support to Ocean Physics?

algorithm.centerCurrent: Separately acquired, not used in candidate radial predicate.
formulas: projection values passed to convergence = Number(value.toFixed(4))
M = valid projections with rounded inward >= 0.05
S = valid projections with rounded inward >= 0.15
O = valid projections with rounded outward >= 0.05
P = unique opposing direction pairs in M
mean = sum(inward in M)/M.length, or null
algorithm.availability: projection.sufficientCoverage === true and >=3 available projections with finite signedRadial/inward/outward. Projection sufficientCoverage is validProjectionCount>=3.
algorithm.pronounced: candidate AND |valid|>=4 AND |M|=|valid| AND |O|=0 AND |S|>=3 AND finite(mean) AND mean>=0.15
algorithm.outputRounding: Returned mean/max values are again rounded to 4 decimals after classification. Thresholds do not compare raw provider components or rounded speedKnots.
algorithm.quality: Finite components/available projections/coverage; no confidence estimate, uncertainty test, magnitude-balance or gradient gate inside convergence.
algorithm.temporal: Individual upstream explicit-assessment age validation; future and available-but-untimed points reject. No convergence cross-vector time equality, compatibility or age cutoff.
algorithm.provenance: Default caller fixes NOAA CoastWatch/noaacwBLENDEDNRTcurrentsDaily and u_current/v_current. Convergence retains upstream contract/limitations, does not compare source release/quality consistency.
algorithm.coverageCaution: Projection requested count is the number of vectors passed in after rejected requests are filtered; complete projection coverage is not automatically four original successful requests.

supported: Existing accepted samples meet the stated inward radial support rule.
Candidate/measurable or pronounced describes that sampled horizontal geometry and existing strength rule.
Missingness and type/state/strength remain distinguishable; availability means evaluable coverage, not candidate presence.
notEstablished: Simultaneous or persistent physical convergence feature
Spatial coherence beyond sampled geometry or independent source agreement
Fish presence, biological effect, habitat quality or catch probability
limitations: Registry declares 0.25-degree grid; exact averaging/support window and provider release/uncertainty are not established for this claim.
Requested geometry is not proof of distinct resolved cells; projection uses cardinal labels.
Mixed represented times and stale components can remain accepted; no currentness upgrade follows.
Three directions suffice; no pairwise magnitude-balance check.
Derived shear/edge/convergence can share observations and overlap.
Synthetic accepted cases do not establish live provider frequency or physical plausibility of every adversarial combination.

mismatch.producer: convergence-candidate / candidate / measurable; no nested currentConvergenceDetected
mismatch.otherRead: buildCurrentEdgeAnalysis:4921 also reads Boolean without state conjunct; not an intermediate translator.

diagnostic.label: NON-PRODUCER DIAGNOSTIC EVIDENCE
diagnostic.operation: Add Boolean true to a clone after actual production trace; direct consumer substitution only.
diagnostic.limits: No producer reachability, scientific intent, probability or score benefit inferred. Prior recomposed confidence/summary/environmentalOpportunityEvidence stayed equal.

questions.question: Define the exact claim supported by candidate and by detected, if detected is justified; distinguish sampled signature from physical feature.
Are the requested 15-nm cardinal geometry, retained resolved coordinates and declared 0.25-degree product grid sufficient for that claim? What spatial limitations must remain explicit?
What represented-time relationship is defensible? Address adjacent/mixed dates, stale components, independently requested last values and partial rejection without inventing a rule here.
What do the existing rounded-projection 0.05/0.15 m/s rules establish? Does available source uncertainty support their intended interpretation? Address unequal magnitudes and opposing-pair support.
How should three directions, absent center, failed requests and unavailable evidence constrain the claim? Does projection coverage describe original requests adequately?
How should candidate convergence overlapping shear/edge be explained without treating correlated outputs as independent confirmation?
Is persistence/continuity necessary for the particular claim, or only for a stronger claim? Specify evidence-based reasoning rather than assuming it is required.
Can a scoped Boolean convey the claim while retaining unavailable/insufficient/not-supported/candidate states, or is another representation needed? No representation selected here.
What evidence may justify one convergence contribution, hydrodynamic-transition-context and an organization-index increment? Distinguish contextual support from an Ocean Signal or Opportunity.
Specify defensible wording and uncertainty for candidate, unavailable and any scientifically justified detected state; exclude vertical/biological/catch claims not established by evidence.
What existing evidence supports each conclusion, what remains uncertain, and is any additional validation necessary before a contract decision? No literature or acquisition is selected here.
Provide an explicit reviewed claim, evidence limits, examples/counterexamples and unresolved issues. Only then can a separate contract/versioning/amendment review define software scope.

prohibitedAssumptions: candidate != detected as an unreviewed permanent scientific axiom
governance: Fail closed without converting unavailable/uncertain to positive support or false to measured absence
Do not let stale/mixed evidence masquerade as current/coherent
Captain decides; product supports rather than replaces judgment
blockedGates: Scientific claim/evidence sufficiency review (this package makes no decision)
Separate contract decision and versioning/compatibility review
Any separately authorized producer/consumer/governance amendment and validation
Subsequent revised-model completeness/qualification and downstream authority gates; no automatic resumption
